sources.title: Country policy and information note: sexual orientation and gender identity and expression, June 2025 (accessible) - GOV.UK
sources.claim_summary: UK Home Office country policy and information note on sexual orientation and gender identity and expression (June 2025): official assessment covering the 'gay propaganda' law - administrative fines or detention up to 15 days, repeat offences escalating to criminal charges with up to 4 years - and the 2023 designation of the international LGBT+ movement as an extremist organisation, punishable with 2-6 years for participation and 6-10 for organising; plus arrest patterns and persecution relevant to asylum claims.

NOTE: fetch blocked by the site's security service (Cloudflare); the underlying source is the US State Department's travel advisory for this country, which advises against all travel for all travellers regardless of personal characteristic - wrongful detention risk, the war, and arbitrary law enforcement.

sources.title: Russia: Rising Toll of LGBT ‘Extremism’ Designation | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch (June 2025): Russian courts have issued 101 'extremism'-related convictions for allegedly participating in the 'International LGBT Movement' or displaying its alleged symbols - approximately 98 administrative and 3 criminal cases; calls on the state to end persecution and on governments to offer protection to those fleeing.
